University Institute of Engineering and Technology
Panjab University, Sector-25, Chandigarh 160014
Corrigendum for Project Staff Requirement
This is in reference to research project “Tele-Health Screening and Management
for Non-Communicable Diseases”, advertisements are published for the post of
Project Scientist- I, Project Scientist-II and Project Technical Support-III. This is to
inform that the last date to apply for the said posts is extended till 7th July 2024
(Sunday).
Dr. Harish Kumar
Principal Investigator and Professor, CSE UIET,
Panjab University, Chandigarh
